operationSemantics: Durable side effects accept an optional idempotency key and return an account-scoped operation receipt.
Receipts distinguish queued, claimed, executing, succeeded, failed, and outcome_unknown.
An execution that may have reached WhatsApp is never retried under the same operation identity.
An AbortSignal cancels the caller wait, not an already durable operation.
resourceOwnership: client.close releases Client subscriptions and opened conversations.
client.close does not stop an application-owned Runtime or close an application-owned Backend.
Closing an opened conversation cancels its page reads and subscriptions without deleting messages or leaving the chat.
example: await conversation.loadOlder(); // saved database rows only

currentPath.behavior: One awaited typed subscription supplies normalized events in source order.
Captures required media bytes, holds the account lease, and submits one accepted batch.
Atomically appends Accepted Source and conditionally changes the Current Mirror; source sequence and mirror revision remain independent.
Memory and libSQL use one projection Module that reads only keyed records touched by the accepted batch.
Publishes a mirror patch only after acceptance commits; connection and presence remain live-only.
Hydrates a snapshot, applies contiguous patches, replaces after gaps, and pages saved messages independently of live watch.

exclusions.summary: Raw queries/nodes, direct relay/proto generation, app-state patches, retries, prekeys, crypto sessions, mutexes, caches, and telemetry remain Adapter internals.
Bot discovery, reach-out limits, chat locks, message caps, and unstable payment/commerce protocol details require a selected caller outcome before normalization.

Application users and roles, OS address books, CRM identity, non-WhatsApp business data, transcription, visual components, routes, URL authorization, notifications, analytics, search, and product scheduling stay outside whatsappd.
